name: stillos-notary-mcp
description: Independent attestation infrastructure for the agentic economy. Every claim is cryptographically signed (Ed25519) and settled against verifiable external ground truth — on-chain state, GitHub, market data, or structured API responses — producing an audit-grade, independently re-verifiable receipt with no reliance on counterparty trust. Complimentary tier, no account required, engineered fail-closed. Institutional capabilities include OFAC SDN entity screening, validated corporate distress scoring, and a bonded dispute-resolution path ($1.00, x402) to formally contest a verdict.
author: StillOS / NolaWealth
